title: Replay of a captured word
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, let $p$ be a valid input-head position, and let $o$ be a Boolean word. For every natural number $j$ with $j\leq |c.output|$, running the threaded-map controller for $j$ steps from its payload-replay state, with capture head at displacement $0$ and output $o$, yields the configuration in that same controller state with input-head position $p$, capture-head displacement $j$, and output $o$ followed by the first $j$ symbols of $c.output$; the simulated machine's tape contents and head positions are preserved.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
replaced:
For every $j$ at most the captured word's length and every prior output
$o$, running the controller for exactly $j$ steps from its payload-replay
state with the capture head at displacement $0$ yields the payload-replay
configuration with the capture head at displacement $j$ and output $o$
followed by the first $j$ captured bits; the bank is preserved.
